name: Transfer Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the assets transfer.

TPLD.name: Pledged Account Transfer
TPLD.definition: Transfer to pledged account (in certain circumstances distributors have to freeze and transfer total or partial holding to separate omnibus account e.g. investigation required by fiscal authority or police).

TTDT.name: TDT Framework Transfer
TTDT.definition: Transfer instruction executed within TDT framework (TDT framework is the operation model promoted by the Italian Banking Association for transfer and most of transfers, but not all, will be executed in accordance with that process).

TRPE.name: Transfer Between Different Beneficiaries
TRPE.definition: Transfer between different beneficiaries with taxation to be applied (accounts with different owner).

TRAF.name: Demerger
TRAF.definition: Transfer is the result of a demerger or division.
